specs: Fully paved trail connecting Smyrna, GA to the Georgia/Alabama border

Bring cell phone, water, safety gear, bug repellent, sunscreen, lip balm, camera, inner tubes, toilet paper or wipes, change

gap: No stated pricing or fees for trail use
blurb: The Silver Comet Trail is a fully paved trail running from Smyrna, GA to the Georgia/Alabama border, connecting with the Chief Ladiga Trail. It is used for biking, walking, and other outdoor activities. The trail passes through Cobb, Paulding, and Polk counties and includes multiple trailheads and amenities along the route.
extraNote: Camping is not allowed on the Silver Comet Trail · Follow trail rules and hours of operation posted at trailheads; fines are expensive · Travel on or near the trail at your own risk; no liability for information accuracy · Multiple trailheads including Floyd Rd Trailhead in Cobb County and Hiram Trailhead in Paulding County
